title: Critical Perspectives: A Benchmark Revealing Pitfalls in PerspectiveAPI

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating toxicity detection models on adversarially crafted comments exhibiting classism (e.g., insulting low-income families) to measure the models' false-negative rates for veiled toxicity.
Testing model detection performance on custom benchmark examples categorized as misogyny, sexual harassment, and gender stereotyping to identify the under-prediction of gender-based toxicity.

Measuring model failure rates on racially exclusionary statements and analyzing false positives triggered by profanity, which the authors note can have disparate impacts across different racial groups.

Comparing model outputs against a custom adversarial benchmark (SASS) and minority-aware human annotations to demonstrate how toxicity models overlook harmful content by over-relying on aggregated majority-opinion training data.
